title: Wither Cloak Plus
description: Changes the Hypixel Skyblock Wither Cloak texture to the old NEU Wither Cloak
body:
# **Hypixel Skyblock Wither Cloak Changer**
**WitherCloakPlus** changes the texture of the Creeper Veil ability from the Wither Cloak Sword to the texture of the old NEU Wither Cloak feature.

It's still **WIP** so it might be a bit buggy.

## Commands
- /withercloakplus status            -   Shows all current settings
- /withercloakplus speed <number>    - Changes the speed at which the Shields revolve around the player
- /withercloakplus count <number>    - Changes the amount of Shields surrounding the player
- /withercloakplus distance <number> - Changes the distance of the Shields from the player
- /withercloakplus toggle            - Toggles the Shield texture
- /withercloakplus reload            - Reloads all values from the config file
